description: Text-to-image (or image-to-image via input_urls). Wrap each request in a 'requests' array, NOT as a flat prompt. Successful items return success_items[].node_id and success_items[].file_name; file_name is the final base filename including its actual extension. To use the generated image, call get_asset_url with this node_id to obtain a short-lived file URL. Optional requests[].output_file sets the downloaded base filename; directory components are ignored. Do not construct an OSS/CDN URL from node_id. Do NOT pass input_files/output_path.

output_file.description: Optional downloaded base filename. Directory components are ignored.
